title: CoordinateZeroBaseChange
statement: Let $P$ be finite purity data and $A=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^{n+1}$, $n\geq0$ [def-pur-conventions]. For any morphism $g:B'\to B$ of separated finite-type $k$-schemes [def-weil-finite-type-morphism], [def-weil-proper-morphism], let $g_c:\mathbf A^c_{B'}\to\mathbf A^c_B$ be the canonical coordinate-preserving base change of the ordered affine tower. Its square with the zero sections $z'_c,z_c$ [def-pur-affine-space-coordinate-boundaries] is Cartesian. Define the normalized closed-constant exchange $g_c^*z_{c*}A_B\cong z'_{c*}A_{B'}$ and the Tate pullback identification of $W_c=A_{\mathbf A^c_B}(c)[2c]$ [def-pur-affine-space-thom-map]. On every bounded-below etale-origin input use proper base change and the proper identifications to define $g_c^*Rz_{c!}\cong Rz'_{c!}g^*$. Define $\mathrm{Ex}_z^!(W_c):g^*Rz_c^!W_c\to Rz_c'^!g_c^*W_c$ as the exceptional transpose of inverse closed exchange followed by $g_c^*$ of the specified exceptional counit [def-weil-exceptional-inverse-image]. Use the section and composition conventions [def-pur-coordinate-section-arrows] and the coefficient pullback conventions [def-pur-coordinate-section-projection]. The necessary pulled-back targets are bounded below of etale origin. No flatness hypothesis or invertibility of this exceptional mate is imposed. The affine map and Cartesian zero square are defined for arbitrary schemes $B,B\prime$ and arbitrary $g$; the exceptional mate above is evaluated on the stated finite-type bases. Exact pullback preserves the bounded-below etale-origin exceptional input and the bounded-below finite Tate target needed for this transpose.

lean.statement: def coordinateExceptionalExchange (P : PurityFiniteSetting.{u}) (n : ℕ) {B' B : Scheme.{u}} (g : B' ⟶ B) (aB : B ⟶ Spec (.of P.field.k)) [LocallyOfFiniteType aB] [QuasiCompact aB] [IsSeparated aB] [LocallyOfFiniteType (g ≫ aB)] [QuasiCompact (g ≫ aB)] [IsSeparated (g ≫ aB)] (c : ℕ) : (inverseImage (setting P n).Coefficient g).obj ((rightDerivedUpperShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (setting P n).Coefficient) (zero B c)).obj (target P n (iteratedAffineLine B c) c)) ⟶ (rightDerivedUpperShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (setting P n).Coefficient) (zero B' c)).obj ((inverseImage (setting P n).Coefficient (spaceMap g c)).obj (target P n (iteratedAffineLine B c) c))
